ashley: quick check — i added a per-model config checksum annotation in TF so k8s deployment picks up changes. planning a small canary to staging, can someone validate the rollout plan?

miguel: on it. did you run `terraform plan -target=module/model-config`? any drift expected?

ashley: ran plan, only annotation changed, no resource replacement expected. plan snippet: `~ kubernetes_deployment.model` (annotation updated)

sam: FYI runtime watches the annotation and triggers an in-process config reload. i also left a fallback to re-read CM at startup.

ashley: worried about thundering reloads during a 50% canary wave. any ideas to smooth it?

miguel: two options: add a short wait between waves in our deploy wrapper (`sleep 15`) or rely on `maxUnavailable` strategy in the deployment to stagger pods.

ashley: example we can use: ```hcl
resource "kubernetes_deployment" "model" {
  spec {
    strategy {
      rolling_update {
        max_unavailable = 1
      }
    }
  }
}
```

lia: also make sure the secret-syncer doesn't touch the checksum label; only the per-model config CM should change it.

deploy-bot: deploy started for staging by @ashley — run id `run-2026-04-XX-001`

ashley: thanks, i'm kicking off canary now, will ping back with results.

sam: if canary fails, what rollback path? do we redeploy old image or restore old CM?

miguel: better to keep previous configmap as `model-config-v<rev>` and set an env var `MODEL_CONFIG_NAME` so we can switch without changing image. avoids image churn.

ashley: good call. i'll update the TF to create versioned CM names and wire `MODEL_CONFIG_NAME` on the deployment. adding to PR.

miguel: small extra check — make sure TF's checksum computation matches runtime's. whitespace/json encoding differences bite us.

ashley: runtime computes `sha256(json.Marshal(cfg))`. TF currently uses `templatefile()` which can leave trailing newlines. i'll switch to `trimspace(jsonencode(var.per_model_config))` in the PR so they match.

deploy-bot: staging canary update: 2/10 pods updated, all liveness/readiness checks passing.

ashley: green on our tests, merging PR #1289 now :tada:

sam: nice, i'll watch logs for reload errors and backoff storms.

lia: leaving a note in the infra release notes about the new annotation semantics and per-model CM naming.

miguel: quick follow-up — someone please run `kubectl get deploy -o yaml` after the canary to confirm `strategy.maxUnavailable` is set as expected.

ashley: will do in a few minutes and paste output here.

deploy-bot: staging canary completed, rollout stable.
